items.exampleEn: Smoking in the forest can endanger many lives.
items.exampleZh: 在森林裡抽菸可能危及許多性命。

items.exampleEn: Scientists measure pollutants in the air every day.
items.exampleZh: 科學家每天測量空氣中的汙染物。

items.exampleEn: You can reclaim your bag at the front desk.
items.exampleZh: 你可以到櫃台領回你的包包。

items.exampleEn: I always buy recycled paper for my printer.
items.exampleZh: 我總是買再生紙給印表機用。

items.exampleEn: Locks are a simple safeguard against theft.
items.exampleZh: 鎖是防竊的簡單保護措施。

items.exampleEn: Our old car was very wasteful with fuel.
Workers purify the water in the town pool every day.
items.exampleZh: 工人每天淨化鎮上游泳池的水。

items.exampleEn: We stayed at an eco hotel in the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 我們住在山上一家環保旅館。

items.sentenceEn: Recycled bottles can become new clothes.
items.sentenceZh: 回收的瓶子可以變成新衣服。

items.audioEn: This machine can purify sea water, so the island now has enough drinking water.
items.audioZh: 這台機器可以淨化海水，所以島上現在有足夠的飲用水。
options: It cleans the plastic from the beaches
It makes sea water safe to drink

items.sentenceEn: Plastic bags are a common pollutant.
items.sentenceZh: 塑膠袋是常見的汙染物。

items.sentenceEn: This filter can purify water from the river.
items.sentenceZh: 這個濾水器可以淨化河水。

items.stemEn: Leaving the lights on all night is very ____.
Hunting may ____ rare animals like this bird.
items.stemZh: 打獵可能危及像這種鳥一樣的稀有動物。

items.passageEn: Our town's river used to be dirty. Factories sent pollutants into the water, which endangered the fish. Ten years ago, the town decided to purify the river. Workers also reclaimed land along the river and turned it into a park. As a safeguard, factories now have to test their water every month. Today, the river is a habitat for many birds, and the park has a small eco center where visitors can learn about the river. The benches there are made of recycled plastic. A sign says, "Don't be wasteful. Take only what you need."
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的河以前很髒。工廠把汙染物排進河裡，危及了魚類。十年前，鎮上決定淨化這條河。工人們也開墾了河邊的土地，把它變成公園。作為保護措施，工廠現在每個月都必須檢測排放的水。如今，這條河是許多鳥類的棲息地，公園裡還有一座小小的生態中心，遊客可以在那裡認識這條河。那裡的長椅是用回收塑膠做的。一個告示寫著：「不要浪費，只拿你需要的。」

questions.questionZh: 作為保護措施，工廠現在要做什麼？
options: 把工廠搬到離河遠的地方

questions.questionZh: 公園的長椅是用什麼做的？

rubricZh: endanger 表示「危及」，例如 endanger animals 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式，如 can endanger 等）

items.promptZh: 只用一次的塑膠杯很浪費。
referenceEn: Using plastic cups only once is wasteful.
Plastic cups that you use only once are wasteful.
rubricZh: 用 wasteful 表示「浪費的」
「只用一次」可寫，例如 using … only once、that you use only once 等
